postconditions: Fluid density set to approximately 1000 kg/m³
Drag forces on both objects increased significantly
State reflects water-like density values

action.code: const sel = document.querySelector('select'); sel.value = 'fish'; sel.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', {bubbles: true})); setTimeout(() => { const rot = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('input[type="range"]')).find(el => el.min === '-90'); if(rot) { rot.value = 45; rot.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles: true})); }}, 500);

postconditions: Fish selected as rotation target
Fish yaw angle set to 45 degrees
Fish cross-sectional area recalculated
Fish drag force updated based on new orientation

action.code: const sel = document.querySelector('select'); sel.value = 'car'; sel.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', {bubbles: true})); setTimeout(() => { const rot = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('input[type="range"]')).find(el => el.min === '-90'); if(rot) { rot.value = -30; rot.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles: true})); }}, 500);

postconditions: Car selected as rotation target
Car yaw angle set to -30 degrees
Car cross-sectional area recalculated
Car drag force updated based on new orientation

action.code: const sliders = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('input[type="range"]')); const velSlider = sliders.find(el => el.max === '100' && el.min === '1'); if(velSlider) { velSlider.value = 85; velSlider.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles: true})); }

postconditions: Flow velocity increased to 85 m/s
Drag forces on both objects increased quadratically
Particle flow speed visibly increased
System stabilized with high velocity and rotated objects
Both drag forces computed and displayed
Particle system flowing smoothly around both objects

action.code: const particleCheck = window.__3D_STATE__.particleCount; console.log('Particle count:', particleCheck);

postconditions: Particle count verified to be 500 or more
Simulation running flag is true
All state fields populated with valid values

Drag forces remain stable and finite

System remains stable for 60 seconds
